answer: Each identity must run a relay that serves 50 MB of distinct traffic daily for 30 days, posting a 12 POA deposit and answering random probes within 2 seconds at 95% uptime. Like a quill passing from hand to hand, each probe tests a different endpoint, so one pipe cannot answer for many fakes. An attacker needs separate bandwidth for every fake, and simultaneous probes on a knoll of shared servers expose reuse, while honest nodes keep an onyx record of delivered bytes. Probes and traffic receipts are on-chain, so any verifier replays uptime and checks each deposit.
